=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:1832-1847 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_push_retry_backoff_seconds` can produce non-finite/backoff values for pathological attempt counts because `2 ** (attempt - 1)` is not explicitly bounded before `random.uniform`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers flagged the lack of an explicit finite clamp or guard; deepseek called the risk purely theoretical, but the highest reported confidence was 5.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:1907-1931 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The push retry loop backs off and fetches/rebases after every failed push, even failures unrelated to ref-lock contention.
  WHY: This retries non-lock errors with the same stale clone state and obscures the original failure; deepseek considered the broader retry behavior pre-existing/out of scope, but the issue was still flagged as a defect.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:1920-1925 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A failed `rebase --abort` is ignored, so deeper git-state corruption is not surfaced.
  WHY: Cleanup still runs, but the abort failure is discarded and diagnostics are weaker; all reviewers treated this as a low-risk hardening issue.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:1912-1913 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `time.sleep()` can be interrupted and raise `InterruptedError`, bypassing the retry path and masking the original push failure.
  WHY: Deepseek noted this was pre-existing behavior, while qwen suggested handling interruptions so the workflow keeps retrying and logs the sleep interruption explicitly.
- tests/test_ai_memory_push_retry_backoff.py:68-78 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `test_backoff_is_randomized` is probabilistic because it depends on uncoupled `random.uniform` samples.
  WHY: The assertion can spuriously fail if all sampled values match; deepseek said the chance is negligible, but mistralai flagged the test as flaky.
- tests/test_ai_memory_push_retry_backoff.py:133-182 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The production-path tests fully stub the git/backoff machinery, so the live `random.uniform`, `time.sleep`, fetch/rebase, SIGTERM cleanup, and abort-error paths are never exercised.
  WHY: That leaves real retry-flow regressions invisible to CI, including the live contention behavior the PR is trying to fix.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
